title: Combinatorial Properties Related to the Higher Baumgartner's Axiom
summary: We isolate two combinatorial properties, each expressible by a $Π_2$-sentence over the structure $(H(ω_3),\in,ω_1,ω_2,\text{NS}_{ω_2})$, such that each property is consistent with CH, and their conjunction together with $2^ω\le ω_2$ and $2^{ω_1} = 2^{ω_2} = ω_3$ implies the existence of a c.c.c. forcing which forces the higher Baumgartner's axiom.
